info.name: E-Commerce - Review Service
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner (the 'Wait for ...' requests retry while Kafka events travel). Needs discovery-server, config-server and all services. Two customers review a phone; one of them buys it, so his review becomes a verified purchase; helpful votes, an edit, moderation and a delete each change the rating, which product-service then shows on the product.

item.name: Wait for the phone's inventory item (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('inventory-service created the item', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Wait for product-service to show the stock (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.availableQuantity === 5; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('product-service shows the stock', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Priya reviews the phone: 3 stars (201, not verified)

exec: pm.test('Shown as Priya S. (never the email)', () => pm.expect(r.reviewerName).to.eql('Priya S.'));

item.name: Priya again (409, one review per product)
Omesh reviews the phone before it arrives: 5 stars
Anyone can read the reviews (no token)

exec: pm.test('No user ids in public', () => pm.response.json().data.content.forEach(r => pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property('userId')));

item.name: Wait for product-service: 4.0 (2) on the product (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.averageRating === 4.0 && pm.response.json().data.reviewCount === 2; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('product-service shows 4.0 from 2 review(s)', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Wait for the order to be CONFIRMED (Kafka)

item.name: Wait: Omesh's review becomes a verified purchase (ORDER_DELIVERED via Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.content[0].verifiedPurchase === true; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('review is a verified purchase', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Priya can't vote for her own review (400)
Priya edits her review to 4 stars

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.averageRating === 4.5 && pm.response.json().data.reviewCount === 2; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('product-service shows 4.5 from 2 review(s)', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('The phone, then the case', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.content.map(p => p.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('phoneId'), pm.collectionVariables.get('caseId')]));
pm.test('Hidden with the reason', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('HIDDEN'); pm.expect(r.hiddenReason).to.eql("Mentions a competitor's shop"); });
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.averageRating === 5.0 && pm.response.json().data.reviewCount === 1; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('product-service shows 5.0 from 1 review(s)', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
